QuestInfo.name: Chief Knight of the Empress
QuestInfo.0: I received a call from #p1101000#, the young Empress herself.
QuestInfo.1: The young Empress thanked me for my efforts in saving Ereve and decided, through my accomplishments and past work, that I would be promoted to the position of Chief Knight. Chief Knight?
QuestInfo.2: I wound up being anointed as the new Chief Knight for the Cygnus Knights. I made a promise to the Empress that the moment the Black Mage reawakens, I will be the first in line to defeat the Black Mage.
